patterns.description: Customers frequently report dissatisfaction with the quality of the food, indicating a consistent problem with taste, preparation, or ingredients.
A significant number of customers perceive the pricing as too high or not offering good value for the quality received.

A notable number of reviews mention various other negative experiences not fitting into specific categories, indicating general dissatisfaction or issues with aspects like portion size, specific menu items, or overall experience.
Several reviews highlight issues with staff behavior, such as unfriendliness, lack of attentiveness, or poor service.
Multiple customers found the restaurant's atmosphere or environment to be unappealing or uncomfortable.

root_causes.pattern: Customers frequently report dissatisfaction with the quality of the food, indicating a consistent problem with taste, preparation, or ingredients.
root_causes.cause: Inconsistent food preparation, low-quality ingredients, lack of skilled kitchen staff, or outdated recipes.

root_causes.pattern: A significant number of customers perceive the pricing as too high or not offering good value for the quality received.
root_causes.cause: Pricing strategy not aligned with perceived food quality or overall dining experience, or insufficient portion sizes for the price.

root_causes.pattern: A notable number of reviews mention various other negative experiences not fitting into specific categories, indicating general dissatisfaction or issues with aspects like portion size, specific menu items, or overall experience.
root_causes.cause: A combination of underlying issues (e.g., specific menu item failures, poor management of special requests, or general operational inefficiencies) not captured by other categories.

root_causes.pattern: Several reviews highlight issues with staff behavior, such as unfriendliness, lack of attentiveness, or poor service.
root_causes.cause: Insufficient staff training, low staff morale, understaffing leading to stress, or lack of proper management oversight.

root_causes.pattern: Multiple customers found the restaurant's atmosphere or environment to be unappealing or uncomfortable.
root_causes.cause: Outdated decor, poor maintenance, inadequate lighting/seating, or issues with noise levels.
